name: Kawasaki Z125 Pro
intro: Kawasaki's mini bike. 2017-2018 bikes have shock and ECU recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2017 bikes are in recall 16V535 (rear shock may leak). 2017-2018 bikes are in recall 17V774 (ECU setting can stall the engine).

recalls.what: Rear shock may leak oil and lose damping.
ECU fuel injection setting can stall the engine at small throttle openings.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new ECU free.
